movement_profile.posture: Mimicking the flight of an eagle

signature_moves.description: The piercing of the skin on the back with a sharp metal hook for suspension.

signature_moves.description: The symbolic movement of the suspended dancer, sometimes pouring flowers on devotees.
signature_moves.name: Eagle Flight

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Physical injury during piercing; only trained ritual practitioners should perform.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythms provided by scores of chenda experts
music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape is dominated by the powerful, sharp cracks and rolling thuds of multiple chenda drums playing in unison, creating a high-energy, percussive environment that lasts throughout the night.

basic_steps: Garuda-vesham: Donning the eagle costume and makeup
Rhythmic night-long dance accompanied by chenda drums
Choondakuthal: Ritual piercing of the back skin with metal hooks
Suspension from the Thooka chadu shaft
Circumambulation: Being carried thrice around the temple while suspended
teaching.formation: Solo or multiple performers on mobile pedestals, boats, or chariots
teaching.level_notes: This is a highly specialized ritual performance restricted to specific devotees and families; it is not a recreational dance.
